title: First animation
description: A box animated on a timeline: the project the First animation tutorial builds. Play it, then make your copy and change the keyframes.

title: First interaction
description: A button that slides a box, with an On pointer event and an action in the interaction graph: the First interaction tutorial's project.

title: Lamp
description: A bulb switched by a button through a boolean variable, with a tap counter in the text and a binding that follows the variable.

title: Canvas tour
description: Two artboards with a sun, a title and pictures: something to pan, zoom, select and rearrange while you learn the canvas and the Layers panel.

title: Blends
description: A ball that mixes between two poses as you drag a slider: a 1D blend of two timelines.

title: Joysticks
description: Two joysticks. Eyes that follow the pointer (two timelines, left-right and up-down, scrubbed from where the pointer is), and a draggable knob that scrubs a sunrise timeline as the joystick's handle.

title: Grid and stack layouts
description: A gallery of tiles laid out as a grid, and a badge stack, with alignment, gaps and spans.

title: Layout item
description: A toolbar and cards where each child sizes itself differently: fixed, hug, fill, percent, grow and aspect ratio.

title: Line gap
description: A wrapping row of cards, to see how the gap between rows and between items is set.

title: Paint order
description: One shape with a fill and two strokes, drawn in different orders.

title: Layers and web controls
description: A card with a headline, a button, a name field, a link, a video and an embed, shapes and paths, driven by three variables and a few interactions.

title: Script, shader and bones
description: A box painted by JavaScript every frame, a box painted by a GPU shader, wavy text, and a two-bone chain moving a picture.

title: Dusk poster
description: A vector poster brought in from a VectorCraft file: gradients and paths, with its twenty stars drawn by one repeated layer.

title: Little house
description: A line drawing of a house, from a VectorCraft file: walls, roof and a sun in groups.

title: Breathing for calm (imported from Rive)
description: A guided breathing exercise imported from a Rive file: a splash screen, choices, progress bubbles and an end screen, with its states and transitions mapped onto timelines and the interaction graph.

title: Text patterns
description: Text with regular expressions in its {} slots: a phone number found in a sentence, a date reformatted, and a pattern that is refused because it could take forever.

title: Bones and IK
description: A three-bone arm with a skinned shape, a draggable orange dot the tip chases (IK), and a Wave timeline on a button. The project the Try bones in two minutes steps build.

title: Matching question
description: Drag each country onto its capital city: a ready-made matching question with scoring, a hint and feedback. Play it, then make your copy and change the pairs.

title: Hotspot question
description: Click the roof of the house: a ready-made hotspot question with a picture, four areas, scoring, a hint and feedback. Play it, then make your copy and change the picture and the right area.

title: Check and fix accessibility
description: A one-page Mars fact that passes the accessibility checks: a heading, a described picture, a clickable dot a keyboard can use, an animation that plays once, and a sensible Tab order. The Check and fix accessibility tutorial's project.

title: Accordion from data
description: Four sections drawn by one repeated section over a list, each opening while the rest move down, one open at a time: the Accordion tutorial's project.

title: Fill in the blanks
description: Four gaps to type into: alternatives, a near number, a pattern and a case that counts, with part marks and a tip for one gap: the Fill in the blanks tutorial's project.

title: Arm rig with bones
description: An arm drawn with the Pen, bound to three bones, that reaches for an orange dot you drag (IK), with a Wave button that plays a keyed pose: the Bones tutorial's project.

title: Branching scenario
description: A group work dilemma with three choices, consequence pages that branch again and three endings picked by the score, with a path so far line and Start again: the Branching scenario tutorial's project.

title: Use the UniSQ look and colour themes
description: A welcome page in the UniSQ Purple colourway where every colour is a theme token, so it also works in Light, Dark and High contrast: the Use the UniSQ look and colour themes tutorial's project.

title: Image slider (carousel)
description: Four slides drawn from a list by one number, with Previous, Next, a dot for each slide, the arrow keys and an autoplay that pauses: the carousel tutorial's project.

title: Before and after compare
description: Two stacked pictures with a divider handle you drag, or move with the keyboard, to show more of one or the other: the Before and after tutorial's project.

title: Personalised for the course and learner
description: Greets the learner by first name, names their course, and gives a different assignment and due week in each course, with a line only staff see: the Course and learner context tutorial's project.

title: Content from a data file
description: A page of study tips where every word, and each card's colour, comes from one JSON file, so rewriting it is a file swap: the Data file tutorial's project.

title: Mind map and flowchart from data
description: A mind map whose branches fold on a click, and a flowchart you follow one answer at a time, each drawn from lists by one repeated box and one repeated line: the diagrams tutorial's project.

title: Drag and drop matching
description: Drag each country onto its capital, with a country that fits nowhere, three tries, part marks and Try again: the Drag and drop matching tutorial's project.

title: Flip cards from a list
description: Six term and meaning cards drawn by one repeated card over a list, each turned over by a click or Enter: the Flip cards tutorial's project.

title: Reflection journal
description: Two reflection prompts with text boxes and word counts that are still there when the learner comes back, and a page that puts it all together and downloads it: the Reflection journal tutorial's project.

title: Label the diagram
description: Four labels to drag onto the parts of a plant, and one that belongs nowhere, checked spot by spot: the Label the diagram tutorial's project.

title: Multiple choice question
description: One multiple choice question with two tries, a hint, feedback for each wrong answer and a result reported when it finishes: the Multiple choice tutorial's project.

title: Memory card game
description: Twelve cards dealt face down from six pairs: turn two, keep a match, watch a miss turn back, with a moves count and a Well done page: the Memory card game tutorial's project.

title: Speaking practice with the microphone
description: A one minute talk the learner records with one button, a countdown that ends the take, a button to play it back and a slider to rate it: the Speaking practice tutorial's project.

title: Put the steps in order
description: Six steps for making a cup of tea, dealt shuffled and moved up and down with buttons that work from the keyboard, with part marks: the Put the steps in order tutorial's project.

title: Which one are you? quiz
description: Three questions whose answers each add to two of three tallies, ending on the result page with the highest score: the "Which one are you?" tutorial's project.

title: Course presentation
description: Four slides on one page master with a title slot, a check your understanding question, and Back, Next and the page number added once to the master by Page navigation with a slide transition: the presentation tutorial's project.

title: Progress, badges and a page master
description: A five-page tour where every page draws the same page master: a panel with a progress bar and three badges that light up as the learner marks each task done: the Progress and badges tutorial's project.

title: Make it work on a phone
description: A page of three cards in a grid, with a narrow variant that stacks them for a phone and swaps in at 600 px: the Make it work on a phone tutorial's project.

title: Click to reveal: image hotspots
description: A picture with three numbered points that each open a dialog, closed by a button or Esc, and turn green once visited: the Click to reveal tutorial's project.

title: Drive an imported animation
description: A bouncing ball imported from a Lottie file, with a Play or pause button and a knob that scrubs it through a joystick: the Drive an imported animation tutorial's project.

title: Animated scene with speech bubbles
description: Sam runs in from the left, then a speech bubble pops up for each speaker, with a Skip button, lines announced to screen readers and a still version for less motion: the Animated scene tutorial's project.

title: When you need a script
description: A spelling question that accepts a near miss: one short script measures how far the typed word is from the answer, and a binding says so in words. The When you need a script tutorial's project.

title: Sort into groups
description: Six energy sources to drag into Renewable and Non-renewable, with each drop answered as it lands and a count of how many are right: the Sort into groups tutorial's project.

title: Sound effects and music
description: Music that starts on the first page and carries on to the next, a sound effect on a button, a sound on or off button and a way to stop the music: the Sound tutorial's project.

title: Poll with a live chart
description: One question with a Vote button, and a bar chart of how the whole class answered, counted and anonymous: the Poll with a live chart tutorial's project.

title: Video with chapters and questions
description: A video with chapter buttons that jump to each part, and two questions that pause it at set times until they are answered: the Interactive video tutorial's project.

title: What-if budget explorer
description: Three sliders for hours, pay and rent, with the income, spending, what is left over and a chart worked out again as you drag: the What-if explorer tutorial's project.

title: Word search and crossword
description: The Word search and Crossword starters with their word lists changed to the water cycle: both grids are made from the lists, so changing the words changes the puzzles. The Word games tutorial's projects, side by side.
